notable_residents_omitted.note: The prompting article names a current resident of this house. Under this site's privacy rules — which bar naming or alluding to current occupants, publicly available or not — that claim is omitted. Past, dated residency tied to a published source may be added later.

sections.heading: Historic status
sections.body: One published account gives San Francisco Landmark No. 197, designated 9 June 1990. The city's per-parcel historic dataset confirms the Article 10 individual-landmark status and the Category A / A* rating, but carries neither the landmark number nor the designation date, so those two figures remain unverified against the landmark ordinance itself.
